permissionMessage: PastPins uses your location to show you on the map and recognize countries you visit.
alwaysPermissionMessage: PastPins uses your location in the background to welcome you to new countries and remind you to mark them visited.
arrivalDescription: Get a friendly reminder when you reach a country you haven’t marked visited. Requires notifications and Always location access. Delivery depends on iOS; reopen PastPins after force-quitting to resume alerts.
arrivalBody: A new place to explore. Tap to add %{country} to your visited countries.
arrivalPermissions: In iOS Settings, allow notifications and set location access for PastPins to Always, then turn on country arrival alerts.
arrivalBuildRequired: Country arrival alerts require an installed build of PastPins. Background location is unavailable in Expo Go.
unavailableMessage: Couldn’t find your location. Try again.
servicesDisabled: Turn on Location Services in iOS Settings, then try again.
permissionDenied: Allow location access for PastPins in iOS Settings.
visitMessage: Add this country to your travels. You can undo this change.
